verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a public REST API with token-based access and per-endpoint references. The Manage Vanta API covers listing tests, documents, policies and evidence, and creating, updating and deactivating controls, uploading and deleting contracts, and assigning owners. A separate Auditor API ships official type-safe SDKs generated from an OpenAPI spec. Probes confirmed the developer docs and llms.txt are publicly reachable, but no OpenAPI file was found at the standard paths tried. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actual API calls, and a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (SDKs are documented only for the Auditor API).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Get an access token and use it to list documents, policies, and evidence in your Vanta tenant, filtered by compliance framework.
Use this API to automate bulk actions, query data for custom workflows and dashboards, and bolster your security operations
Vanta publishes official, type-safe SDKs for the Auditor API. Each SDK is generated from the same OpenAPI specification
Attach an evidence file to a Vanta document and submit it for review, using the Manage Vanta API.
